[b][size=4] Features [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The onsen/hot spring is fully functional as a mini-bathhouse and will restore your stamina and health. [b][color=#9fc5e8]Change to swimsuit[/color], [color=#e06666]enter pool[/color], [color=#f6b26b]change out of swimsuit[/color]; behind the bamboo.[/b]
[*]You can refill your watering can, game's water flowing sound fx.
[*]Go to sleep at [b][color=#00ff00]lounger[/color].[/b]
[*][b][color=#fff2cc]Glowing hotspring flowers[/color][/b], [color=#00ffff][b]glowing plants[/b][/color], and [b][color=#fff2cc]candle lanterns[/color][/b] function as [b][color=#ffff00]light sources[/color].[/b]
[*]Greenhouse, sunroom, conservatory, and garden igloos have diggable tiles, greenhouse map property.
[*][b]Indoor Lighting changes:[/b] [b][color=#ffd966]Daytime sunny[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]rainy/Night time[/color][/b], [b] [u][i]b r e a t h i n g[/i][/u][/b] light rays:P
[*]Grows any season crops, including winter seeds.
[*][b]Grows any season trees, wild trees will grow [/b](trees can be tapped)[b];[/b] fruit trees & wild trees requires non-dug tiles around tree to grow.
[*]Deck in Sunroom buildings to decorate with vanilla/CP furniture
[*][b]Seasonal windows [/b](syncs/works automatically with world recolour mods)
[*][b]Weather synchronised dynamic windows[/b] (couple of petal/leaf variations to match with various recolour/reshade mods)
[*](CP add-on for "Aqua" buildings) Aquarium functional [b]fish tank windows[/b] - [u]allows duplicates but limited[/u] to 35(?) per tank (fish + ground + deco + other ([b]unless[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11388]Increased Fish Tank Capacity[/url])
[*]Build on [b]farm only[/b] ([i]not anywhere like TMX version[/i])
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]'s [b]instant build[/b]
